name: Gabar Goshawk
shows: Southern Pale Chanting Goshawk (adult, taking off with prey)
reason: Very pale grey bird with plain unbarred grey chest and only fine vermiculated barring on belly, long red-orange legs, black-and-white tail and black primaries contrasting with pale wing; lacks Gabar's darker grey tone and boldly barred grey tail. Fits SPCG, as Bernard suspected.
